ambientCG.finding: All downloadable assets and preview renders are CC0. This importer downloads original 1K color maps only.
ambientCG.apiFinding: Official API is provided to search and download assets using code. Serialized requests and cache avoid repeat load.
ambientCG.robotsFinding: Allow root except /hx/. Registered API/download paths are allowed.

polyHaven.finding: Original asset files are CC0. Website renders, logos and avatars have separate restrictions; none are collected.
polyHaven.apiFinding: API free for commercial and research use; unique User-Agent required, clear provider credit when surfacing live API content. Motion Lab preserves sourceName and original source link and serves downloaded images locally.
polyHaven.robotsFinding: Prefer public API; account, client-navigation and search-query website paths disallowed. API robots returns 404 (no directives).

collectionControls: Stop on 403 or 429; no alternate provider access to bypass a refusal
Bounded bytes, static image magic and pixel dimensions
Read only one registered ZIP color entry, no archive extraction
Original SHA-256 and provider MD5 when supplied
JPEG re-encode strips EXIF; complete original albedo preserved
No thumbnails or PBR channels counted as new assets
